title: 4. Checks on what agents write
description: These sources carry their text, so claims with a quote go through the Researcher's checks. Zenith's claim is faithful to its quote and is accepted. Acme's certification claim quotes a real registry line but states a different standard: that is laundering a lie through a trusted source, and it is refused. Acme's price claim quotes text that is not in the page: refused. Refused claims never get support, so they stay red. Try this: edit a quote or a claim, reload, and see what the checks say.
